name: Saruyama
source:
A physical education teacher who had his sights on Mayumi.
However, Mayumi leaves for Himejima Academy without him being able to do anything.
He tries to contact Mayumi when she returns. 

[From [url=http://www.terra.dti.ne.jp/~f-rui/works/myworks/jmkyoutou/jmkyoutou.html]Official site[/url]]
